summary: Frontend-only testing of the /admin access bug fix (AdminDashboard.jsx inline key login form) plus full admin regression. All 8 bug-fix scenarios PASSED: (1) /admin without ?key shows 'Masuk Dashboard Admin' card with admin-key-input (type=password), admin-key-submit and back-home-btn; (2) empty submit shows toast 'Masukkan kunci admin' with ZERO requests to /api/admin/verify (verified by request interception) and stays on the form; (3) wrong key 'wrong-key' -> toast 'Kunci admin salah. Coba lagi.' shown, stays on login form, URL remains /admin (backend returns 401 - expected, logged as console 401 only); (4) valid key 'labkom-admin-2026-secret' -> URL becomes /admin?key=labkom-admin-2026-secret and dashboard loads with all 4 tabs (admin-tab-registrations/contacts/gallery/reviews); (5) direct /admin?key=<valid> loads dashboard with no login form rendered (count=0); (6) direct /admin?key=xxx renders login form (no crash) and correct key entry recovers into the dashboard; (7) back-home-btn navigates to /; (8) mobile 390x844: login form fits with zero horizontal overflow, full-width submit button, login->dashboard works. Regression on dashboard: 4-tab switching all render correct panels; date filter 18 -> 0 rows for 2020 window and Reset now correctly restores 18 rows with cleared inputs (iteration-4 stale-closure bug CONFIRMED FIXED, reset-filter-btn testid now present); gallery add via URL (3 -> 4 items + success toast + form reset) and delete of the created item (4 -> 3 + confirm dialog + toast) work; gallery upload mode toggle renders gallery-file-input; review hide -> 'Ulasan disembunyikan' and approve -> 'Ulasan disetujui' both work (state restored, no reviews deleted); refresh-btn reloads data without errors. No JS console errors other than the expected 401 for invalid-key verify calls.

issues: Logo/title block and Refresh + 'Ke Website' links crowd each other; 'PANEL KONTROL INTERNAL' wraps to two lines and sits directly under the Refresh control - consider stacking or hiding the subtitle below sm breakpoint
Still uses native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy US format) instead of shadcn Calendar, inconsistent with the Indonesian UI (carried over from iteration 4, cosmetic)

critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx: submitKey is declared inside the `if (verified === false)` branch - it is re-created on every render and mixes control flow with component definition. Consider hoisting it to the component body (useCallback) for readability.

Successful login navigates with the key in the query string, so the admin secret ends up in browser history / Referer / ingress logs. Consider storing it in sessionStorage after verify and dropping it from the URL.
No rate limiting on /api/admin/verify: the new login form makes brute-forcing the single shared key easier from the browser. Add throttling on failed attempts.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted gallery item 'TEST_QA_Iter5_Foto' via the admin UI. Review approval states were toggled and restored to their original values. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login flow: go to /admin, fill admin-key-input with 'labkom-admin-2026-secret', click admin-key-submit -> redirects to /admin?key=... Add a ~3s wait between consecutive toast assertions (sonner toasts persist and can cause false positives). Gallery delete button needs .hover() on the gallery-item-<id> card first on desktop. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' for page.goto (networkidle times out on this app). Iteration-4 open defect (filter Reset stale closure) is fixed and re-verified.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: users hitting /admin without ?key only saw a static 'Akses Ditolak' screen with no way to enter the key. Fix adds an inline verify form on the verified===false branch that POSTs to /api/admin/verify and navigates to /admin?key=... on 200. Verified working for empty / wrong / valid key and for wrong keys supplied directly in the URL.
